rationale: The agent found that mergeLayers was called with fileLayer applied after envLayer, so any env var was silently overridden by the file for every key, not just cache.ttlSeconds; swapping the merge order fixes the whole class of inputs and the entire _PROD_OVERRIDES workaround array/loop was deleted rather than extended. The production-only log-level suppression (SEC-207) is left untouched and is covered by a new regression test.
